gate: A bargain wants to be made. That is the felt shape of this code as a gate, the pull toward agreement, toward the handshake that binds a small group into a workable whole. It carries the emotional charge of friendship and family, the loyalty that holds a clan together over time. The drive is for the bond to be fair, for the giving and the getting to balance out, for promises to land where they were aimed. Most people read this code as softness, as a sweet sociability that loves to please. The misread is large. What moves underneath is closer to a contract, an emotional accounting that keeps watch over who fed whom, who showed up, who slipped away. Break the bargain and this code does not stay polite. It tracks. It remembers. The friendship in it is real, and so is the cost of betraying it.
centre_field: The body-map seats this code in the emotional solar plexus, the motor that runs on feeling and the awareness that processes it. That double duty is the whole teaching. Friendship here is not a thought about other people. It is a chemistry, a wave that rises and falls, a weather that fills the room before anyone has spoken. The desire to belong is wired into the same circuitry that produces moods, passions, and the slow build of resentment when a bargain goes unhonoured. Because the wave is tribal in flavour, the buildup is quiet. Things get stuffed, smoothed over, kept civil. Then a small broken promise lands and the whole pressure releases in one outburst that surprises everyone present, the speaker most of all. The placement explains why this code cannot stay only sweet. It is a feeling motor with a stake in the family, and feeling motors do not stay level.
channel: Friendship needs somewhere to land. On its own, this code is all reach, all the warmth of the bargain offered up and waiting for a counterpart. What it reaches toward is the gate of aloneness, the willpower that has learned to stand by itself before it agrees to belong. The two together form the channel of community. The reach makes the structure visible. Belonging that has not first known solitude collapses into enmeshment, a friendliness with no spine. The aloneness gives the bond a backbone, the strength to say yes and to say no, the will that lets a person actually deliver on the agreement they signed up for. Without that other half, this code keeps making bargains it cannot quite hold, drawing the tribe close and then resenting the weight of it. Joined, the bargain becomes a community, and the community can actually carry its members.
